messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — PR #4237 added an 'example extractor' section to the structured-output guide but two issues I spotted: the inline link to the JSON schema 404s, and the JS SDK snippet still uses the old `function_call` config (we migrated to `tool_call`).

mike: omg thanks for catching. I noticed the link yesterday but didn't file a follow-up. Where's the schema supposed to live?

sara: It should point to /docs/schemas/structured-output-v2.json (we moved to the `v2` filename last quarter). PR used /schemas/structured-output.json — 404.

kevin: For the SDK snippet, change this: `model.calling = { function_call: 'auto' }` -> `model.calling = { tool_call: 'auto' }`. Also update example comments mentioning "function calling" to "tool calling" for consistency.

dana: Minimal fix plan: 1) replace link to v2, 2) update snippet and a short note about migration, 3) add a tiny test in docs CI to assert schema link resolves. Happy to push a quick follow-up commit to the branch.

sara: Perfect. Could you also add a one-line migration note: "If you previously used `function_call`, update to `tool_call` — see SDK migration section" ? We want searchability.

mike: I can add the CI link-checker entry — two lines. Will run locally then push.

dana: Pushed changes to branch: added schema link fix + snippet rename + migration note. PTAL.

sara: Reviewing now. Looks good but the JS snippet still has `// older clients use function_call` comment — please remove to avoid confusion.

dana: Removed the comment and expanded the example to show both Node and Python minimal snippets. Kept them < 10 lines each.

kevin: lgtm from SDK POV. One tiny nit: in the Node example we call `await model.generate()` but elsewhere we use `await model.invoke()` — decide on one. I prefer `invoke` for tool calls.

dana: Switched to `invoke` for both.

merge-bot: build/ci-docs-link-checker — ran. All good except one transient 502 on external CDN (retrying).

mike: Link-checker now green locally. Re-ran CI.

merge-bot: build/ci-docs-link-checker — success.

docs-bot: Quick note added to changelog: "Docs: fix structured-output example extractor link; clarify SDK migration function_call -> tool_call" (changelog entry id: docs-4237-fix).

sara: Thanks everyone — merging once CI finishes. We should add a short follow-up to the migration guide later showing a side-by-side before/after for larger teams.

dana: Agree; I'll create a tiny follow-up PR for expanded migration examples.

sara: Merged 🎉. Closing this thread.
